messages:
maya: Drafting internal release note for smart-batching rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need sign-off on pinning, canary sizes, and rollback triggers. Deploy window 09:00-10:00 PT.

dev-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued dpl-4920 for 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z. Canary -> ramp -> full. React :rocket: to lock.

sam: Can we get the per-region pin matrix and a one-line customer impact blurb?

maya: Pin matrix draft (will add to RN doc):
```yaml
us-west-2:
  model: rwlm/batching-optim
  version: v2.0.0
  rollout: canary 5% for 30m -> 25% -> 100%
eu-central-1:
  model: rwlm/batching-optim
  version: v1.9.5
  rollout: canary 2% for 60m -> 10% -> 50%
fallback_version: v1.9.3
metrics_watch: p95_latency > 220ms OR error_rate > 1.2%
```

lina: For EU dedicated tenants, keep v1.9.5 pinned (no auto-upgrade). Add a warmup grace_period=15m for KV caches to avoid transient p95 spikes.

ops-oncall: Rollback sketch: 1) pause dpl-4920 2) reroute traffic to fallback v1.9.3 3) run sanity tests for 10m 4) publish rollback note + webhook to CS. Will paste checklist shortly.

ryan: Minor tweak: use p95 > 200ms for short prompt SLA-sensitive routes and 220ms otherwise. Also include eval-suite ID in RN.

maya: Note added: eval-suite/2026-03-22-quick-check shows throughput +12% on short prompts, memory +3% on long contexts; hallucination delta +0.4% (within threshold). Attaching CSV link in doc.

marco: Security review: no new secrets path, KMS validated, enterprise tenants remain opt-in for upgrade.

sam: Here's a short internal blurb to post in the announcement channel: 
- What: smart-batching runtime (reduced per-token overhead, KV warmup)
- Affects: hosted public + dedicated pools (see pin matrix)
- Window: 09:00-10:00 PT (canary first 30-60m)
- Rollback criteria: p95 latency breach, error_rate spike, or eval regression >1%
- Oncall: @ops-oncall, @ryan standby

dev-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deploy cue template accepted. Please include realtime monitors and incident channel.

sam: Pushing RN draft to /docs/internal/releases/2026-03-23-batching-optim.md now. Will pin and ping ops at T-15m.

ops-oncall: Rollback checklist (compact):
1) run `deploybot pause dpl-4920` or pause in UI
2) `routing set --model rwlm/batching-optim --version v1.9.3 --regions eu-central-1,us-west-2`
3) run sanity probes: `curl -s -X POST https://api.prod/redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` repeat for 10m and confirm error_rate <1%
4) post summary in #incident-dpl-4920 and update the RN with rollback time + reason

ryan: I'll be oncall and watching p95 dashboards. If we see sustained breach for 4 continuous minutes, I'll trigger pause.

kai: Security/infra OK from my side. Add note that dedicated customers will be notified by CS before any manual pin changes.

maya: Final call: merging RN in 20m unless objections. Will post T-15m internal announce and pin this thread.

marco: no objections from security.

maya: merged. :thumbsup: Thanks all — see you during the window.
